description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git merge scenarios involving various file operations such as modifications, renames, directory renames, and conflict resolution. It defines multiple test setup functions and verifies merge behaviors in different branch and file change scenarios.

methods.name: test_setup_1a
methods.description: Sets up a Git repository with initial, A, and B commits for merge test scenario without renames.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for a specific merge scenario.

methods.name: test_setup_2a
methods.description: Sets up a Git repository for merge scenario involving rename on B.

methods.name: test_setup_2b
methods.description: Sets up a Git repository for merge scenario with changes and rename on A.

methods.name: test_setup_2c
methods.description: Configures a repository with changes and renames on A/B leading to expected conflicts.

methods.name: test_setup_3a
methods.description: Prepares a repository with directory renames and file renames for merge tests.

methods.name: test_setup_3b
methods.description: Creates a repository where directory and file renames are combined with changes for testing merges.

methods.name: test_setup_4a
methods.description: Sets up a scenario with local modifications, and changes on A and B for merge involving dirty state.

methods.name: test_setup_4b
methods.description: Prepares repository with renames and modifications, testing merges with local changes present.
